name: State Management Reviewer
description: Validates state management patterns, ensuring alignment with Clean Architecture, SOLID, and the project's Container/Presenter pattern. Enforces best practices for Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and React state usage. Detects over-rendering, state leaks, improper selector usage, and architecture violations.

checks.description: Presenters must not directly manage business logic state. They may only consume state via hooks/selectors provided by containers or domain layers.
checks.exampleBad: LoginPresenter uses useState to handle domain-driven form state.
checks.exampleGood: LoginPresenter receives domain state from useLoginContainer() hook.

checks.description: Redux slices must contain initialState, reducers, and optionally extraReducers. Avoid business logic inside reducers; keep them pure.
checks.exampleBad: Reducers with async code or side effects.
checks.exampleGood: Side effects handled in thunks or sagas.

checks.description: Selectors should be memoized with createSelector to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
checks.suggestion: Wrap selector in createSelector or use shallow equals when mapping.

checks.description: Zustand stores must follow best practices: no async logic inside setters, separate selectors, and state must be serializable.
checks.exampleGood: Store exposes actions; async behavior happens outside setters.

checks.description: Detects state variables that are local UI state but placed in global Redux/Zustand store.
heuristics: string or number not referenced in more than 1 file
state used only by a single component
checks.exampleGood: isModalOpen handled in a local useState.

checks.description: Side effects (API calls, async operations, caching logic) must occur in containers, not presenters.
checks.exampleGood: Container fetches data and passes formatted output to presenter.

checks.description: Detects duplicated pieces of state across Redux, Zustand, and local component state. Ensures a single source of truth.
checks.detectionStrategy: Flags variables with identical names and purposes across layers.

checks.description: Detects excessive renders due to unstable callback dependencies, large objects in state, or improper memoization.
flags: functions defined inside renders without memoization

checks.description: Mutating state outside of Redux Toolkit's Immer context is forbidden.
Domain-specific state must live in the correct domain folder, not globally.
checks.exampleBad: Vendor filters placed in global filters slice.
